Now I need to determine what molecular formula corresponds to this mass. Let me analyze:

For a mass around 178 Da, I need to consider common elements (C, H, O, N, etc.).

The isotope pattern is important:
- The M+1 peak is 11.4% of the base peak
- This suggests the presence of carbon atoms (each carbon contributes ~1.1% to M+1 due to 13C)
- 11.4% / 1.1% ≈ 10-11 carbon atoms

[M+H]+ = 179.11572 Da
